table.retrieve:
SELECT
	SubReportCode=1,
	ReportType = 'Item Activity',
	Godown = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL GODOWN' ELSE (SELECT Godown.Name FROM Godown WHERE Godown.GCode = :ai_gcode) END,
	SalesMan = CASE :ai_smancode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL SALESMAN' ELSE (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = :ai_smancode) END,
	GroupCode = CASE :as_type WHEN 'M' THEN I.ManfCode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode 
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
				 ELSE I.PackCode END,
	Groupname = CASE :as_type WHEN 'M' THEN ISNULL((SELECT Manufacturer.name FROM Manufacturer WHERE Manufacturer.ManfCode = I.manfcode), '')
			WHEN 'C' THEN ISNULL((SELECT ItemCategory.name FROM ItemCategory WHERE ItemCategory.ICatCode = I.icatcode), '')
			WHEN 'L' THEN ISNULL((SELECT ItemClass.name FROM ItemClass WHERE ItemClass.ICCode = I.iccode), '')
			ELSE ISNULL((SELECT itempacking.name FROM itempacking WHERE itempacking.PackCode = I.packcode), '') END,
	ICode=St.Icode,
	AliasName= i.customicode,
	Description = i.name,
	packingdesc=max(i.packingdesc),
	Rate = Round(i.saleprice/case when i.packunits > 0 THEN i.packunits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	INQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' OR Type = 'PV' OR type='RV' OR type='AI' OR type='TI' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	OutQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='PR' OR type='IV' OR type='DS' OR type='AD' OR type='TO' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SaleQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SaleValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	SRetQty	  =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN qty ELSE 0 END),
	SRetValue =SUM(CASE WHEN type='SR' THEN value ELSE 0 END),
	NetSaleQty = SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN qty WHEN type='SR' THEN - qty ELSE 0 END),
	NetSaleValue = SUM(CASE WHEN type='SV' THEN value WHEN type='SR' THEN - value ELSE 0 END),
	ClosingStockQty = SUM(CASE WHEN type='OP' OR Type = 'PV' OR Type = 'SR' OR type='RV' OR type='AI' OR type='TI' THEN qty ELSE - qty END)
FROM 
	Item i,
	(SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = sum(qty), value=0
	FROM	
		(select	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
				when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				else looseqty + bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND 
			pd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN pd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			pl.postdate < :adt_startdate
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	pd.icode, qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
		WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND 
			pd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN pd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			pl.date < :adt_startdate
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
		WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND 
			sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			sl.date < :adt_startdate AND sd.Due IS NULL
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND 
			sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			sl.postdate < :adt_startdate
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
		WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND*/ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND 
			sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			sl.date < :adt_startdate
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.qty)
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND 
			sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			sl.postdate < :adt_startdate
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND 
			sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			sl.posteddate < :adt_startdate
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND 
			sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			sl.date < :adt_startdate
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.qty)
		FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
			sl.SGcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sl.SGCode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			sl.postdate < :adt_startdate
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.qty)
		FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
			sl.DGcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sl.DGcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			sl.postdate < :adt_startdate
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select	d.icode, qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND 
			d.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN d.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
			h.duesatisfydate < :adt_startdate
		Group By d.icode
/*		UNION ALL
		select	icode, qty = 0.0000
		FROM Item*/) A
	GROUP BY icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PV',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(case pl.purcatcode when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty) * packunits
				else (looseqty + bonusqty) end),
		value = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
			when 1 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			when 2 THEN (packqty + bonusqty)
			else looseqty + bonusqty 
			end, 0) * pd.purprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
		pd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN pd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		pl.postdate BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='PR',
		pd.icode,
		qty = sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits),
		value = sum((pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits) *
			pd.prprice * (1 - pd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - pl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
	WHERE pl.posted = 'Y' AND pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
		pd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN pd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		pl.date BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By pd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.saleprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND SD.Due IS NULL AND
		sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		sl.date BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='SR',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits),
		value = sum((sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + sd.packqty * sd.packunits) *
			sd.srprice * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01) * (1 - sl.discperc * 0.01))
	FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
		sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='IV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
	WHERE /*sl.posted = 'Y' AND */ sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
		sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		sl.date BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='DS',
		d.icode,
		qty = sum(d.duesatisfyqty),
		value = sum(d.duesatisfyqty * (d.packsaleprice / case d.packunits when 0 then 1 else d.packunits end))
	FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
	WHERE h.duesatisfycode = d.duesatisfycode AND
		d.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN d.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		h.duesatisfydate BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By d.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='RV',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * sd.saleprice)
	FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
		sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
		sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		sl.posteddate BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='AD',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.looseqty),
		value = sum(sd.looseqty * sd.price)
	FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
		sd.Gcode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sd.gcode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		sl.date BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='TO',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * (sd.saleprice / CASE sd.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE sd.packunits END))
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
		sl.SGCode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sl.SGCode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	select	type='TI',
		sd.icode,
		qty = sum(sd.qty),
		value = sum(sd.qty * (sd.saleprice / CASE sd.packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE sd.packunits END))
	FROM THeader sl, TDetail sd
	WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Transcode = sd.Transcode and 
		sl.DGCode = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN sl.DGCode ELSE :ai_gcode END AND 
		sl.postdate BETWEEN :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
	Group By sd.icode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT type='OP', icode, qty = 0, value=0 FROM ITEM) St
WHERE st.icode = i.icode
GROUP BY St.icode, i.name, i.customicode, i.saleprice, i.packunits, i.manfcode, i.icatcode, i.iccode, i.packcode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	SubReportCode=2,
	ReportType = 'Sales Summary Statistics',
	Godown = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL GODOWN' ELSE (SELECT Godown.Name FROM Godown WHERE Godown.GCode = :ai_gcode) END,
	SalesMan = CASE :ai_smancode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL SALESMAN' ELSE (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = :ai_smancode) END,
	GroupCode = NULL,
	Groupname = NULL,
	ICode=NULL,
	AliasName= NULL,
	Description = T.Remarks,
	packingdesc=NULL,
	Rate = 0,
	INQty	  = 0,
	OutQty	  = 0,
	SaleQty	  = 0,
	SaleValue = SUM(T.Value),
	SRetQty	  = 0,
	SRetValue = 0,
	NetSaleQty = 0,
	NetSaleValue = 0,
	ClosingStockQty = 0
FROM
	(SELECT 
		remarks='Less Discount', 
		value = - (select sum(sl.flatdisc) from saleledger sl where sl.date between :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate AND 
			sl.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT SD.SaleInvCode FROM SaleDetail SD WHERE SD.GCode = CASE  :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode END))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		remarks='Add Miscellaneous Charges', 
		value = (select sum(sl.misccharges) from saleledger sl where sl.date between :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate AND 	
		sl.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT SD.SaleInvCode FROM SaleDetail SD WHERE SD.GCode = CASE  :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode END))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		remarks='Less Discount', 
		value = - (select sum(ISNULL(B.invdiscperc,0)) 
		from
			(select invdiscperc = IsNull( sum(Round(((d.looseqty + d.packqty * d.packunits) * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc)),2)) * 0.01 * s.discperc, 0)
			from saleledger s, saledetail d
			where 
				s.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT SD.SaleInvCode FROM SaleDetail SD WHERE SD.GCode = CASE  :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode END) AND
				s.date between :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate AND
				s.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode 
			group by s.saleinvcode, s.discperc) as  B)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		remarks='Add/Less Rounding Difference', 
		value = (select sum ( ISNULL(A.rounddifference,0)) 
		from
			(SELECT 
				rounddifference= Round(Sum ( d.looseqty * d.saleprice)
				- Round(Sum (Round(( d.looseqty  * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc) * (d.discperc * .01)) + (d.looseqty  * d.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
				- Sum ( Round(d.looseqty   * (d.saleprice  - d.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (d.discperc * .01)),2)) * (s.discperc /100) 
				+ s.misccharges - s.flatdisc,0)  
				-
				(Sum ( d.looseqty * d.saleprice)
				- Round(Sum (Round(( d.looseqty  * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc) * (d.discperc * .01)) + (d.looseqty  * d.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
				- Sum (Round( d.looseqty   * (d.saleprice  - d.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (d.discperc * .01)),2)) * (s.discperc /100)
				+ s.misccharges - s.flatdisc),
				netammount= (Sum ( d.looseqty * d.saleprice)
				- Round(Sum (Round(( d.looseqty  * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc) * (d.discperc * .01)) + (d.looseqty  * d.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( d.looseqty * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (d.discperc * .01))) * (s.discperc /100), 2) + s.flatdisc + s.misccharges )
			FROM saleledger s, saledetail d
			WHERE 
				s.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT SD.SaleInvCode FROM SaleDetail SD WHERE SD.GCode = CASE  :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode END) AND
				s.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and 
				s.salecatcode IN (3,1) and  
				s.date between :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
			GROUP BY s.misccharges, s.flatdisc, s.date, s.saleinvcode, s.discperc, s.salestax, s.salecatcode) as A)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		remarks='Less Cash Returns', 
		Value= - (select  ISNULL(sum(isnull(c.invsalereturn,0)),0)
		from (select
			invsalereturn= IsNull( Round(sum(Round(((d.looseqty + d.packqty * d.packunits) * d.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc)),2)) * (1- (.01 * s.discperc)) + s.misccharges - s.flatdisc,0),0)
			+ /* Add Item level salestax*/
			Round( Round(	Sum (Round (d.looseqty * d.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( d.looseqty * d.srprice * (1 - d.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * d.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
			+ /* Add Invoice lever salestax*/
			Round ( (Sum ( d.looseqty * d.srprice)
			-    Round(Sum (Round( d.looseqty  * d.srprice * (d.discperc * .01),2)), 2)
			-  Round(Sum (Round( (d.looseqty  ) * d.srprice * (1 - (d.discperc * .01)),2)) * (s.discperc /100), 2)
			- s.flatdisc ) * s.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
			,0)/* end of sales tax round*/
			,0)/* end of main null function*/
			from srledger s, srdetail d
			where 
				s.SRInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT SD.SRInvCode FROM SRDetail SD WHERE SD.GCode = CASE  :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode END) AND
				s.srinvcode = s.srinvcode and s.srcatcode IN (8,6) and 
				s.postdate between :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
			group by s.srinvcode, s.srcatcode, s.date, s.discperc, s.misccharges, s.flatdisc, s.invgstperc1) as C)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		remarks='Less Total Credit Sales', 
		value = - (select ISNULL(sum (isNull(d.creditsale,0)),0)
		from (select creditsale =  IsNull( Round(sum(Round(((d.looseqty + d.packqty * d.packunits) * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * d.discperc)),2)) * (1- (.01 * s.discperc)) + s.misccharges + s.salestax - s.flatdisc,0)
				+ /*add invoice level salestax*/
				Round(Round ( (Sum ( d.looseqty * d.saleprice) 
				-   Round(Sum (Round(( d.looseqty  * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc) * (d.discperc * .01)) + (d.looseqty  * d.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) 
				-  Sum (Round( d.looseqty * (d.saleprice  - d.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (d.discperc * .01)),2)) * (s.discperc /100)
				- s.flatdisc ) * s.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
				+ /*add Item level salestax*/
				Sum (Round (d.looseqty * d.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (d.looseqty *(d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - d.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * d.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
				,0) /* end of sum of tax round*/
				,0)/* end of main null round*/
			from saleledger s, saledetail d
			where 
				s.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT SD.SaleInvCode FROM SaleDetail SD WHERE SD.GCode = CASE  :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode END) AND
				s.date between :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate AND
				s.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and s.salecatcode = 2   
			group by s.saleinvcode, s.salecatcode, s.date, s.discperc, s.misccharges, s.salestax, s.flatdisc, s.invgstperc1)as D)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		remarks='Add Total Tax', 
		value = (SELECT ISNULL( SUM(Round(INV.itemsalestax + invtax,0) ),0)
		FROM
			(Select itemsalestax = Sum (Round (d.looseqty * d.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (d.looseqty * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - d.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * d.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
				invtax=	Round ( (Sum ( d.looseqty * d.saleprice) 
					-   Round(Sum (Round(( d.looseqty * (d.saleprice - d.itemflatdisc) * (d.discperc * .01)) + (d.looseqty  * d.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) 
					-  Sum (Round( d.looseqty   * (d.saleprice  - d.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (d.discperc * .01)),2)) * (s.discperc /100)
					- s.flatdisc ) * s.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
			from saleledger s, saledetail d
			WHERE 
				s.SaleInvCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT SD.SaleInvCode FROM SaleDetail SD WHERE SD.GCode = CASE  :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN SD.GCode ELSE :ai_gcode END) AND
				s.saleinvcode = d.saleinvcode and 
				s.date between :adt_startdate and :adt_enddate
			GROUP BY s.misccharges, s.flatdisc, s.date, s.saleinvcode, s.discperc, s.salestax, s.invgstperc1) as INV)) T
GROUP BY
	T.Remarks
UNION ALL
SELECT
	SubReportCode=3,
	ReportType = 'Receipt/Collection/Recovery From Customer',
	Godown = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL GODOWN' ELSE (SELECT Godown.Name FROM Godown WHERE Godown.GCode = :ai_gcode) END,
	SalesMan = CASE :ai_smancode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL SALESMAN' ELSE (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = :ai_smancode) END,
	GroupCode = A.SubCode,
	Groupname = (SELECT SA.NAME FROM SubAccounts SA WHERE SA.SubAccCode = A.SubCode),
	ICode= D.AccCode,
	AliasName= A.AliasName,
	Description = A.Name,
	packingdesc='.',
	Rate = 0,
	INQty	  = 0,
	OutQty	  = 0,
	SaleQty	  = 0,
	SaleValue = SUM(D.Credit),
	SRetQty	  = 0,
	SRetValue = 0,
	NetSaleQty = 0,
	NetSaleValue = 0,
	ClosingStockQty = 0
FROM
	Accounts A, GLHeader H, GLDetail D,
	(SELECT SM.SalesManCode 
	FROM SalesMan SM 
	WHERE SM.SalesManCode = CASE :ai_smancode WHEN -1 THEN SM.SalesManCode ELSE :ai_smancode END 
	UNION 
	SELECT SalesManCode=-1
	FROM (select a=0) T
	WHERE -1 = CASE :ai_smancode WHEN -1 THEN -1 ELSE :ai_smancode END) S
WHERE
	ISNULL(H.SManCode, -1) = S.SalesManCode AND
	H.Posted = 'Y' AND
	H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	H.AccCode IN (SELECT AC.AccCode FROM Accounts AC WHERE AC.SubCode IN (2,4)) AND
	H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND
	A.SubCode = 3 AND 
	D.AccCode = A.AccCode AND 
	D.Credit > 0
GROUP BY
	D.AccCode, A.AliasName, A.Name, A.SubCode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	SubReportCode=4,
	ReportType = 'Other Expenses',
	Godown = CASE :ai_gcode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL GODOWN' ELSE (SELECT Godown.Name FROM Godown WHERE Godown.GCode = :ai_gcode) END,
	SalesMan = CASE :ai_smancode WHEN -1 THEN 'ALL SALESMAN' ELSE (SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesManCode = :ai_smancode) END,
	GroupCode = A.SubCode,
	Groupname = (SELECT SA.NAME FROM SubAccounts SA WHERE SA.SubAccCode = A.SubCode),
	ICode= D.AccCode,
	AliasName= A.AliasName,
	Description = A.Name,
	packingdesc='.',
	Rate = 0,
	INQty	  = 0,
	OutQty	  = 0,
	SaleQty	  = 0,
	SaleValue = - SUM(D.Debit - D.Credit),
	SRetQty	  = 0,
	SRetValue = 0,
	NetSaleQty = 0,
	NetSaleValue = 0,
	ClosingStockQty = 0
FROM
	Accounts A, SubAccounts SA, CategoryAccounts CA, MainAccounts MA,
	GLHeader H, GLDetail D,
	(SELECT SM.SalesManCode 
	FROM SalesMan SM 
	WHERE SM.SalesManCode = CASE :ai_smancode WHEN -1 THEN SM.SalesManCode ELSE :ai_smancode END 
	UNION 
	SELECT SalesManCode=-1
	FROM (select a=0) T
	WHERE -1 = CASE :ai_smancode WHEN -1 THEN -1 ELSE :ai_smancode END) S
WHERE 
	ISNULL(H.SManCode, -1) = S.SalesManCode AND
	H.Posted = 'Y' AND
	H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	H.AccCode IN (SELECT AC.AccCode FROM Accounts AC WHERE AC.SubCode IN (2,4)) AND
	A.SubCode = SA.SubAccCode AND
	SA.CatAccCode = CA.CatAccCode AND
	CA.MainAccCode = MA.MainAccCode AND
	MA.MainAccCode = 5 AND
	A.AccCode = D.AccCode AND
	H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode
GROUP BY
	D.AccCode, A.AliasName, A.Name, A.SubCode
ORDER BY 
	SubReportCode, ReportType, Godown, GroupName, Description
